svg.text: near floor: FP32 below 10% top-1, so the cost says little
Colour: the measured cost. Dot: large cost (whole interval more than 5 points below full size).
dark = darkness · blur = defocus blur · noise = noise (Brokkr), gaussian noise (ImageNet-C) · contr = contrast · s = severity
